Graduate School of Precision Engineering at the University of Bern
The Graduate School of Precision Engineering (GSPRE) at the University of Bern presents a specialized and highly competitive PhD program and is run by the Faculty of Science.
The program provides a comprehensive and innovative PhD education that challenges students to deepen their knowledge, produce independent scientific work, and become leaders in the future of precision engineering research.
News
Second edition: GSPRE symposium 2026
On Friday, June 26, 2026, the Graduate School of Precision Engineering (GSPRE) hosted its second symposium at the ExWi building of the University of Bern. Held under the theme “Precision Engineering Across Scales,” the symposium brought together researchers, industry partners, and students to foster interdisciplinary exchange and discussion.
READ MORE
Prof. Dr. Johann Michler appointed titular professor at the University of Bern
As of 1 November 2025, Prof. Dr. Johann Michler has been appointed Titular Professor at the University of Bern. Congratulations!
Already a valued lecturer in the MSc Precision Engineering program of the School of Biomedical and Precision Engineering (SBPE), he continues to contribute his extensive expertise in materials science and the mechanical behavior of micro- and nanostructures.

Successful First GSPRE Symposium
On Monday, June 23rd 2025, the GSPRE hosted its first symposium in Bern, bringing together researchers, industry partners, and students for lively exchanges.

METAS and SBPE Launch Strategic Partnership
The Swiss Federal Institute of Metrology (METAS) and the School of Biomedical and Precision Engineering (SBPE) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to establish a long-term collaboration in precision engineering and metrology.
